title: [10] Implement video calls with cross-platform support
why_we_need_this: Users need the ability to make video calls to each other directly from the app. Video calls must work cross-platform (web, mobile, desktop) to ensure all users can communicate regardless of their device!
acceptance_criteria:
- User can initiate a video call to another user from the chat interface
- Recipient receives an incoming call notification and can accept or decline
- Video call supports real-time two-way video and audio streaming
- Video call works cross-platform: web browsers, iOS, Android, desktop
- Call UI includes controls: mute/unmute audio, enable/disable video, end call
- Call quality adapts to network conditions
